decisions.reason: §1 shows build at 16:22 preceded the 16:23 bump, PLUGIN_VERSION was inlined at build time and not read at runtime, the corrected order adds an artifact grep gate, mirror integrity is kept but correctly shown irrelevant, and v0.3.8's later order is not confused with the v0.3.7 build.

§2 uses the probe triple: refresh shows the toggle, PNG 200 proves the route exists, SVG 404 exposes the running old whitelist against a correct disk file; the boot-time closure requires a full host restart, with the conclusion kept specific to this host lifecycle.
§3's three-way verdict localizes the splice to upstream result-text assembly; the disk file is innocent, must not be repaired, and the payload is treated as untrusted input.

§4 orders disk bytes via the asset route, DOMParser/parsererror validation before using the payload, a sandboxed iframe without allow-scripts but with SMIL, and an explicit reason-carrying error state; a validation failure never reaches the iframe unchecked.

§5 explains decoding all concatenated frames in order (CLI or frame loop), reconstructing and diffing the stored JSONL text against the source, and reporting upstream; the checklist covers bump-before-build, shipped-constant verification, per-mirror tag SHA, and plane-aware probes.

caps.reason: Advice mandates bump-before-build and a pre-push constant gate, treats tag rewriting only as a risky last resort, requires host restart for host-half changes, and validates XML before any render with scripts blocked.
